name: Once Betrayed Now Unstoppable
overview: In the past life, Hector was ignored by his family and killed by Danilo. He was left disappointed and exhausted. Then, he woke up and discovered that he had come back to life, returning to his birthday ten years ago. At age 12, Héctor was taken to the Rivas family. However, his relatives valued another adopted son, Danilo, more, while they would only show him coldness and misunderstanding. In his past life, Danilo slandered him, saying that he had added an allergenic jam to the cake. This time, Danilo did not defend himself, but decided to break with the Rivas family and left home.
